id.description: Native id placed on the `<button>`; the rendered label uses `aria-labelledby` to name it (label id is derived as `${id}-label`).

checked.description: Whether the toggle is currently checked. Bindable — defaults to false.

label.description: Visible label text. Always the accessible name, even when `labelVisible` is set. Required.

disabled.description: Prevents interaction when true. Sets `disabled` attribute.

readonly.description:
Shows the setting without letting a press change it, for a value that something else owns,
such as a schedule defined in a file. The switch stays focusable, announces
`aria-readonly="true"`, ignores a press on the track or the label, and still submits its value
with a native form (unlike `disabled`).

pending.description:
Shows that the setting is being read or changed and a press has to wait, such as a switch
whose consequence is still being looked up. The switch announces `aria-busy="true"` and
`aria-disabled="true"`, shows a small spinner in its thumb, and ignores a press on the track,
the label or the state words. It stays focusable, so focus is not lost when it starts or
stops, and it keeps its value and its colour (unlike `disabled`, which greys it).

description.description:
Short visible text beside the label that describes the switch, such as the file that defines
it ("Defined in workflows/release-notes.json"). It is wired into `aria-describedby`.

descriptionVisible.description:
Whether `description` is drawn. Set `false` for a description that only a screen reader needs,
such as the consequence of flipping a switch whose reason the page already says in words: it
stays wired into `aria-describedby` and is visually hidden.

descriptionPlacement.description:
Where `description` sits. `inline` is on the label's line, for a few words ("Defined in
workflows/release-notes.json"). `below` stacks it under the label, with the switch beside both,
for a sentence that explains what the switch does.

mutating.description:
Marks a switch that changes something. Inside a stale `<StaleRegion>` it goes inert:
`aria-disabled`, still focusable, ignoring the press, and described by the region's reason.
It returns by itself when the region stops being stale.

nameDetail.description:
Words that follow the visible label in the accessible name only, such as the thing the switch
belongs to ("Daily summary schedule" makes the name "Active, Daily summary schedule"). The
visible label stays first, so the name keeps WCAG 2.5.3 (Label in Name). The name is then the
switch's `aria-label`, written as one string so every platform reads it alike.

labelVisible.description:
Whether the label is visibly rendered. Set `false` for icon-only or
inline contexts — it stays the accessible name.

standalone.description:
Makes the switch its own field: it is named and labelled by its own `label` even inside a
`<FormField>` or `<SettingRow>`, whose label would otherwise name it. Use it for one switch
among several in a field, such as a list of agents in a setting.

labelPosition.description:
Which side of the switch the label sits on. `start` puts the label first and spreads the two
across the switch's full width, the way a list of switches reads; `end` keeps them together.
Applies to a visible label that the switch owns (outside a field, or `standalone`).

name.description:
Form field name. When set, a hidden checkbox mirrors `checked` so the toggle
participates in native form submission. Omit for purely client-side toggles
(no hidden input is rendered, so there is zero overhead).

value.description:
Value submitted for the hidden checkbox when `checked` and `name` is set.
Mirrors native checkbox semantics: the pair `name=value` is sent only while
checked. Defaults to `'on'`. Ignored when `name` is unset.

form.description:
Associates the hidden checkbox with a form by id, matching the native
`form` attribute. Lets the toggle submit with a form it is not nested in.
Ignored when `name` is unset.

class.description: Additional class names merged with `.cinder-toggle` on the switch button.

unsupportedProps.name: onValueChange
unsupportedProps.description: Notify after the bindable value has been committed.

unsupportedProps.name: onValueChangeRequest
unsupportedProps.description: Intercept a proposed checked state before the bindable value is written. Return a replacement value to transform it.

unsupportedProps.name: stateText
unsupportedProps.description:
Words beside the switch that follow `checked`, such as `{ on: 'On', off: 'Off' }`: the `on`
word while checked, the `off` word otherwise. They sit next to the switch, so with
`labelVisible={false}` they are the only words drawn. They are decorative (`aria-hidden`): the
label stays the accessible name and `aria-checked` carries the state. A press on them flips the
switch, as a press on the label does.
